type MaybeVoid = number | void;
function a(x: MaybeVoid) { console.log(x); }
a();
function g<T>(x: T | void) { console.log(x); }
g<string>();
g();
class C { constructor(x: boolean | void) { console.log(x); } m(y: string | void, z: void) { console.log(y, z); } }
new C().m();
const fn: (p: number | void) => void = (p) => console.log(p);
fn();
const target: () => void = a;
target();
function f(x: string | void) { console.log(x); } f();
const h = (x: number, y: void | boolean) => console.log(x, y); h(1);
